name: Corpse Bride Halloween costume transformations
what_it_is: Videos show people doing Halloween costume transformations and cosplay of Emily, the Corpse Bride from Tim Burton's film — blue-grey skin, veil, floral crown and corset — often set in front of a church or in a bedroom mirror, with several asking "did I win this trend?" A few related clips show the original stop-motion characters, a bride/ghost costume variant, and a lookalike-comparison video.
